top_signals.title: Onchain data casts doubt on insider-trading theory in NYT’s ‘suspicious’ election betting story
top_signals.summary: The New York Times reported on 'suspicious' bets, but two experts who reviewed The Block's findings said the evidence doesn't strongly suggest foul play.
